result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers catch the marketplace-template leftovers ($0.00, the generic hero copy, the vague Explore and Get Started buttons, the ambiguous Add tab) and tie their points to specific lines in the spec. B gives more concrete, product-grounded replacements: availability labels, a 'due back Thursday' status line, and hero copy that mentions the community hall. B also says outright that it held back on visual judgment. A defines the card fields more thoroughly, but it never offers actual seed examples. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): B does more to point out the placeholder content: it names 'Item Title / Short description' and the hero copy, and it questions what 'Explore' and 'Get Started' actually do. A gives better grounded example replacements, such as copy about the community hall cupboard, an availability status instead of a price, and a due-back status line. Neither answer flags 'User Name' or 'user@example.com' as placeholders, and both stay off visual design.
